value.text: Exchange with Isabella d'Este on her portrait by Leonardo, 26 and 29 April 1498

claims.statement: Isabella d'Este wrote from Mantua on 26 April 1498 asking Cecilia to lend her portrait by Leonardo; Cecilia replied from Milan on 29 April 1498 that it had been painted when she was young and she no longer resembled it. A thanks note of 18 May 1498 follows. Archivio di Stato di Mantova.
